subject: NovaPay: anomalous API token activity — IR artifacts request
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novapay.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Lenora Park <lenora.park@novapay.com>, security@novapay.com
Date: Sat, 06 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Anomalous token use detected — request for logs and IR plan

Hi Grace,

We observed a brief spike of failed API calls tied to a NovaPay-issued API token this morning (~2027-03-06T08:45Z). Calls originated from an IP range we don't normally see for our production traffic. We sandboxed the token and rotated credentials, but we'd like Redwood to share: 

- A brief timeline of the event as seen on your side (first/last observed, impacted endpoints)
- Temporary mitigation steps you applied (token rotation, IP blocking, rate limits)
- A copy of your incident response plan (IRP) or the specific runbook you followed for token compromise scenarios
- Any logs, request traces, and a packaged evidence bundle we can use for our audit team (redacted where appropriate)

Can you confirm you received this and provide an ETA on artifacts? Our compliance team is preparing an internal incident report and will want your postmortem for their record.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Alex Rivera
Security Operations Manager
NovaPay
alex.rivera@novapay.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novapay.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 07 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Anomalous token use detected — request for logs and IR plan

Alex — thanks for the heads-up and for rotating the token. We saw the same activity and initiated our containment playbook. Quick answers up front: 

- Timeline (high level): first anomalous request 2027-03-06T08:42:13Z, last unusual request 2027-03-06T08:51:57Z.
- Impacted surface: token-scoped access to the /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate endpoints; no customer data exfiltration detected in initial scans.
- Immediate mitigations: token revoked, associated client IPs blocked at the edge, and increased logging verbosity for the session window.

We will:
1) Produce an evidence bundle (logs, request traces, IDS alerts) and 2) share our IR playbook excerpt covering compromised API tokens.

Mina will assemble the package and post to a secured Google Drive folder; Michael will draft a short postmortem and action items for your auditors. Expect the evidence bundle by EOD Tue (2027-03-09) and the postmortem by Thu (2027-03-11).

For internal tracking, I'll open JIRA-IR-378 and add you as an external watcher.

If you need any specific log formats or a hash for the bundle, tell us now and we'll include it.

Grace O'Connor
Security & Trust Lead | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novapay.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2027 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Anomalous token use detected — request for logs and IR plan

Alex / Grace,

Attached is the evidence bundle we promised: novapay_ir_evidence.zip (contains redacted request logs, NGINX access slices for the 09:42–09:52 UTC window, application-level traces, and IDS alerts). Links/notes below: 

- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Novapay-IR-Evidence (access granted to alex.rivera@novapay.com)
- Bundle contents (top-level):
  - 2027-03-06_access_slice.log (NGINX request lines, redacted IPs)
  - app_traces_03-06.jsonl (token-bound traces, redacted user_ids)
  - ids_alerts_03-06.csv (IDS signature matches)
  - checksums.sha256 (SHA-256 for the ZIP)

Notes on redaction and limitations: we removed session-level user identifiers and customer payloads where they contained PII. The traces show repeated attempts to call the embeddings endpoint with short payloads, consistent with token-guessing or credential stuffing.

I'll follow up with the playbook excerpt as a separate attachment (redwood_ir_checklist_v1.2.docx).

Attachments: novapay_ir_evidence.zip

Mina Haddad
Incident Response Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novapay.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 11:01:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Anomalous token use detected — postmortem and remediation steps

Alex — attached is our postmortem PDF (redwood_postmortem_2027-03-11.pdf). Summary highlights:

- Root cause (probable): exposed API token in a third-party CI log (we observed a single outgoing request pattern consistent with token leak to an unapproved integration).
- Impact: transient unauthorized API calls; no verified data exfiltration.
- Mitigations taken: token rotation, IP blocks, temporary tightening of rate limits for new tokens, and a forced refresh window for long-lived tokens created in the prior 30 days.
- Short-term next steps (completed): updated our detection rule set to flag token creation + immediate external IP access; added a TTL enforcement on tokens older than 90 days.
- Longer-term action items: integrate token scanning into onboarding pipelines; add automatic token expiration for keys provisioned via the console; run a SIG questionnaire update to call out token lifecycle controls.

I've added a section titled "Audit artifacts" with pointers to the Drive bundle (same folder Mina shared) and checksums. We can produce an auditor-friendly package (PDF + signed hash) if NovaPay wants that for its compliance folder.

Attachments: redwood_postmortem_2027-03-11.pdf

Michael Grant
Head of Incident Response | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.inference.com
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novapay.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Anomalous token use detected — postmortem and remediation steps

Team — thanks for the fast, thorough work and the clear postmortem. I confirm receipt of novapay_ir_evidence.zip and redwood_postmortem_2027-03-11.pdf; checksums match. A couple quick items: 

- Our auditors would like a signed hash file and a short statement of redaction decisions for their evidence binder. Can you produce a one-paragraph attestation and the signed checksums?
- We'd like to schedule a 30-minute call to walk the postmortem and discuss the SIG questions you mentioned. Is Tue 2027-03-15 10:00 AM PT possible?

If both are doable, we'll close the incident on our side and loop in procurement to post the updated contract appendix for token lifecycle controls.

Thanks again — Alex

Alex Rivera
Security Operations Manager
NovaPay
